findings.issue: Memo 5.1 cites the MIND Council as "Section 8 (Masterplan for Infrastructure and National Development (MIND) Council)", but Part IV and the fiscal rows treat Section 8 as the mainstreaming provision and Section 9 as the Council's composition; the section reference in the memo is wrong.

Both overlaps are between two bodies whose functions this same bill assigns (the Council under s10 and DEPDev under s11), not with an existing body; framing them under the merger and consolidation authority of RA No. 12231 and saying the bill does not abolish "either function" misstates what Part VI is testing.
findings.quote: the DEPDev shall, in coordination with concerned agencies and stakeholders, be responsible in the formulation of the detailed CIDMP

findings.issue: Memo 6.2 states RA No. 12231 was signed on August 4, 2025 and describes its Section 6; neither the date nor the content of that section is in the material provided, so both should be verified before release.

The cost engine marks its estimate as applicable, but the output overrides it without explanation beyond saying no office is created, while still quoting the new-office ranges in 5.1 and the fiscal rows and offering the 15 to 60 position estimate as a gross reference in 5.4; quoting figures declared inapplicable invites misreading.
findings.quote: The DEPDev shall serve as the Secretariat and shall provide administrative, operational, and technical support to the Council.

findings.issue: The output assumes the s11 workload can be absorbed by existing DEPDev staff without examining its scope, which includes monitoring the physical and financial performance of all implementing agencies and socio-economic impact, plus the s10 duty to review and streamline all existing policies.
findings.quote: including the physical and financial performance of implementing agencies, and the socio-economic impact of program accomplishments

findings.issue: The recommendation issues list says "Clarify funding sources and amounts under Section 15", but Part V (5.2, 5.3) only asks that the agencies concerned be named and routes amounts through the regular budget process; the issues list and 7.2(e) do not match on amounts.
findings.quote: shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the departments/agencies concerned

findings.issue: BMB-C is referred on a coverage match to GOCCs with budgetary support, but nothing in the quoted sections involves a GOCC, so the reason is unsupported; meanwhile the bureau covering DEPDev, the agency the output says bears most costs, is not referred.
No cost is noted for the s10 duty to consult major private sector stakeholders, LGUs, CSOs and NGOs, or for producing reports to Congress, which fall on the Secretariat.
findings.quote: Consult with major stakeholders from the private sector, including but not limited to the business groups, LGUs, civil society organizations, and non-government organizations
